Customer Case Study

Customer Case Study

>> Features of Tennis Simulator:


  • Pain Point Breakdown: Why Digital Tennis is Your Venue Transformation Catalyst

  • Traditional Arcade Center Dilemma

    		 Traditional Indoor Playground Bottleneck
    Extreme Homogenization: Players quickly lose interest; low retention and zero long-term loyalty. Strict Age Ceiling: Restricts traffic to ages 3–7; customers are permanently lost as children grow.
    Lacks Fitness/Health Appeal: Parents actively limit children's screen time on traditional video games. Zero Parental Engagement: Parents remain passive onlookers, missing out on family-unit monetization.
    Low ROI Per Sq. Meter: Bulky machines serving only single players cap floor revenue potential. No Coaching/Training Value: Unable to upsell higher-ticket structured coaching or tournament services.


>> Advantages and Applications for the Tennis Simulator:


  • Break Age Barriers & Unlock "Whole-Family" Spending: Built-in 【Kids 2P Battle】 and 【Honeycomb Blitz】 arcade modes allow toddlers to play easily; 【Professional Match】 and 【Forehand/Backhand Training】 modes engage teens and adults, transforming a toddler zone into a family sports destination.

  • Smart Ball Launcher + Auto-Ball Recycling System for Unattended Operation: Equipped with patented ball launchers and automated ball collection/recycling systems, supporting coin, card, or QR payment. Fully customizable coin/duration settings minimize staff overhead.

  • Visual Data Feedback Driving High-Frequency Repeat Visits: Post-game metrics display ball speed, return rate, and calorie expenditure alongside local leaderboards, triggering player competitiveness and social sharing for repeated plays.

>> Three Core Multi-Functional Operational Modes



  • ModeCore Features & Gameplay  PDFBusiness Value (What It Delivers)Match ModeAttracts adult players and tennis enthusiasts, creates a competitive atmosphere, and enables local in-store tournaments.Training ModeFunctions as a value-added training module charged hourly or per lesson, significantly boosting average ticket size (ARPU).Amusement ModeCaptures toddler and family traffic, driving queueing effects and maximizing machine turnover rate.


  • Authentic tennis rules with Clay, Grass, and Hard court options; supports 1/3/5 set matches with custom service types (Free, Forehand, Backhand).

  • Customizable feed intervals (e.g., 4s) and session durations; target landing zone locking with real-time speed and calorie tracking.

    Includes 【Match3 Pop】, 【Kids 2P Battle】, and 【Honeycomb Blitz】 casual mini-games designed for easy entry.

>> FAQs for Tennis Simulator:


Q1: What are the space requirements for the LJ Digital Tennis Simulator?

A1: Standard footprint requirement is just 4m (W) × 10m (L) × 3m (H), customizable to fit your specific venue layout. It requires only a flat indoor floor and a standard 220V power supply. We provide complete framing guidance and integrated ball recycling collection to minimize floor footprint.


Q2: How do payment customization and unattended operation work?

A2: The system features a built-in commercial Payment Setting menu with toggleable coin/card/scan modes. You can freely set coins per game (e.g., 1 coin/play), session duration (e.g., 180s), and admin access passwords. Combined with patented ball delivery and high-framerate optical/infrared tracking, operators only need periodic ball refills.


Q3: What warranty and software support are provided?

A3: Guangzhou Liangjia Sports Technology (LJ Sports Tech) holds full independent R&D patents for ball launchers and trajectory tracking positioning. We deliver full original hardware setups (including industrial host PC, Epson projector, IR sensors, high-speed camera, and high-impact impact screen) alongside long-term OTA software updates and technical support.


Q4: Can I play against other users online?

A4: Yes, the Tennis Simulator supports multiplayer duel modes, allowing you to compete against other players online or in split-screen mode.


Q5: How do the AI opponents adjust to my skill level?

A5: The AI adjusts its difficulty based on your performance, providing a dynamic challenge that grows with your skill level.
